sources.title: Hermes 2 Pro Llama 3 8B official model card
sources.evidence: Exact variant, Hermes family, Nous authorship, Llama-3-8B base, llama3 license, ChatML dialogue, function calling and schema-guided JSON; text generation examples.

sources.title: Released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 attention/8 KV heads, vocabulary 128288, untied embeddings, float16, max_position_embeddings=8192 and no RoPE scaling. Dense per-layer attention/MLP configuration.

sources.title: Complete four-shard checkpoint index
sources.evidence: 291 named tensors mapped to four main checkpoint shards; total_size=16061046784 bytes. All indexed names matched the inspected shard headers, with no missing or duplicate tensors.

sources.title: Official repository metadata and safetensors summary
sources.evidence: Public, ungated repository; revision f798274b30e7d2d4797c369edcc0cc7473b6e6f2. Safetensors metadata reports 8030523392 F16 parameters. Separate dpo-adapter artifacts are also present; they are not added again to the complete merged checkpoint.

sources.title: Checkpoint shard 1 safetensors header
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 range reads fetched the 8-byte header length and 9432-byte JSON header only. Contains 82 F16 learned weight tensors totaling 2488475648 logical parameters; no quantization scales, packed storage or buffers.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3 model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly describes autoregressive Transformer architecture, GQA, text-only inputs, text/code outputs and 8192-token training sequences. Applied only through the exact model card base mapping and matching released configuration.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the Meta Llama 3 Community License Agreement. Supports the current exact variant card license tag; the license date is the base model date, not the Hermes release date.

sources.title: Nous Research Hermes 2 Pro Llama-3 8B launch announcement
sources.evidence: Official account announces this exact Llama-3 8B model available on Hugging Face, with function calling and structured output. X official oEmbed supplies May 1, 2024; the normal x.com page returned 403.

sources.title: Official X syndication record for launch announcement
sources.evidence: Returns NousResearch author, exact-model launch text and created_at=2024-05-01T21:12:21.000Z for status 1785779313826308096.

sources.title: Official checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Initial repository commit and weight uploads occurred April 30, 2024; model card created at 18:40 UTC that day. This history dates artifacts but does not record when repository visibility became public. Latest revision is a September 14 template fix.

sources.title: Hermes function-calling reference implementation
sources.evidence: Default model path is Hermes-2-Pro-Llama-3-8B and examples cover function-call parsing/execution and JSON generation. The later scratch_pad reasoning section is explicitly labeled Hermes-3; it is not exact-target reasoning evidence.

sources.title: Explicitly linked Llama 3 base model documentation
sources.evidence: The target card identifies this repository as its base. Its README reproduces Meta Llama 3 model details and license, establishing the link to Meta documentation; no Hermes release date or active count is inferred from it.

sources.title: Initial April 30 model card
sources.evidence: Initial card already identifies exact Hermes 2 Pro Llama-3 8B variant and base. Its old apache-2.0 metadata differs from current llama3 metadata; current exact repository card and linked base license are used. No explicit public release date appears.

name.note: Matches the exact model heading and official launch.

developer.note: Official Nous repository and announcement; card credits collaborators.

family.note: Hermes-series grouping; Llama 3 identifies the base architecture lineage.

release_date.note: Earliest explicitly verified public launch announcement. April 30 dates checkpoint uploads and card creation, not a verified public-visibility transition. May 27 provider listings are later and are not adopted.

open_weights.note: The complete main checkpoint is publicly downloadable; all four shard headers were accessed without authentication.

license.note: Current card specifies llama3 and maps to the licensed Llama 3 base. Initial Apache-2.0 card metadata was subsequently changed; the current exact model designation is retained.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete merged checkpoint: 8030523392 learned parameters across 291 F16 tensors. All names end in .weight and are model embeddings, attention/MLP matrices or learned norms; no buffers/scales. Header tensor products match both HF metadata and 16061046784/2 bytes. Independent configuration arithmetic: 2*(128288*4096) + 32*(2*4096^2 + 2*4096*1024 + 3*4096*14336 + 2*4096) + 4096. Nominal name is 8B. Separate DPO adapter files are not double-counted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate per-token active count is reported for this exact checkpoint. Dense architecture does not establish equality with total, especially with embedding lookup; retain null.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only autoregressive Llama Transformer with GQA and gated SiLU MLPs. Config and complete tensor inventory show one ordinary attention/MLP block per layer, no experts or router.

context_window.note: Released config sets max_position_embeddings=8192 with no RoPE scaling; the explicitly mapped base documents 8192-token context/training. This is checkpoint capacity, not a guarantee about every third-party API deployment.

modalities.note: Text token inputs and text/code outputs; configuration contains no vision/audio components.

reasoning.note: No exact-target declaration establishes dedicated reasoning-mode support or its absence. The reference repository scratch_pad section explicitly belongs to Hermes 3. Clear the baseline false; general reasoning benchmarks do not resolve this capability flag.

tool_call.note: Explicit function-calling training and tool-use format; model emits calls for application code to execute.

description.value: Llama 3 fine-tune optimized for function calling, structured JSON responses, and dialogue
description.note: Concise description matches the documented training and prompting capabilities; retained without benchmark claims.

patch.notes: Complete main FP16 checkpoint contains exactly 8.030523392B learned parameters (291 tensors), independently reconciled with configuration arithmetic; 8B is nominal. Active count is not separately disclosed. Current card specifies llama3 despite initial Apache-2.0 metadata. Public launch announcement is May 1, 2024; April 30 is the earlier repository artifact-upload date, with historical public visibility unverified. Reasoning-mode support remains unverified; Hermes 3 scratch_pad documentation is not transferred.

summary: Replaces nominal model-name-derived 8B with the complete verified 8.030523392B checkpoint count and establishes dense Transformer architecture. Uses May 1 public announcement rather than April 30 artifact creation as the verified launch; historical visibility on April 30 remains unknown. Confirms name, developer, family, open weights, current Llama 3 license, 8192 checkpoint context, text modalities, function calling and description. Active count stays null; unsupported reasoning=false is cleared. No Mistral Hermes, Hermes 3 or unrelated revision specifications were transferred.
